text: Both classical and behavioral approaches fail to account adequately for preference reversal, and that joint failure, not mere novelty, is what justifies an alternative quantum decision framework.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
abstract: However, proponents of quantum economics argue that the failure of both classical and behavioral approaches to adequately address preference reversal highlights the need for an alternative approach.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to preference reversal and similar context dependent decision anomalies
